svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What survives imperfect supervision
svg.desc: A cluster of inliers, only some of them labeled positive, with an adversarial tail of corrupted points. As the corruption arrives, the mean is dragged toward the tail while the geometric median stays with the inliers. Supervision may be corrupted, incomplete, indirect, or model-generated; robustness here means a high breakdown point, estimating only what is identifiable, never treating unlabeled data as negative, and keeping valid minority evidence.

g.text: how much corruption before it fails
what the data can still pin down
ESTIMATE WHAT IS IDENTIFIABLE · BOUND WHAT IS NOT · NEVER MANUFACTURE LABELS
